title: Unctuous Charred Syrian Lamb Stew
description: A rich and flavorful Syrian lamb stew with a charred twist, featuring tabasco sauce and slow-cooked to perfection in a kadhai.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a kadhai over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the kadhai and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the kadhai and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tabasco sauce, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the kadhai and stir to combine.
Add the browned lamb back to the kadhai and pour in the chicken broth.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2.5 hours.
Remove the kadhai from the heat and let the stew rest, covered, for 10 minutes.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Char the top of the stew with a kitchen torch, if desired.
